prompt:
Create a new highest-quality professional AAA game character concept sheet for an original MERIDIAN protagonist in 2043, in a realistic dark near-future setting. Reference image 1 is Concept01 / Cutline; reference image 2 is Concept01 / Overlap. These are visual direction references, not targets to reproduce unchanged. Follow their compact angular closed helmet, opaque black visor, shallow hard mask, graphite composite, muted olive and ash textiles, athletic human proportions and understated tactical design. Make the new character CLEARLY MORE ARMORED than either reference, while remaining agile and human-sized: thin articulated chest/back/flank/abdomen protection, small outer shoulder caps, forearm shells, thigh plates, isolated knees and shins. Flexible textile at all moving joints, clear shoulder stock seats, narrow waist, normal shoulders, no tank-like silhouette, powered armor, exoskeleton, huge pauldrons, rigid limb tubes or excessive pouches. Completely conceal all face, eyes and skin in every external view.
VARIANT 16 / DATUM, based on the artist's new design matrix: cropped octagonal breast and back plates, THREE separate abdominal armor bands, sliding flank leaves; single tapered upper-thigh plates and separate knee/shin pieces. Compact helmet with broad opaque visor beneath a distinct narrow central crown strip; paired shallow hard jaw panels; flush temple service pocket containing the onboard computer. Protected display optics sit behind the visor. Credible recessed service seams and small internal electronics, no dangling cables, large attachments, external holograms or glowing eye lights. The helmet computer renders the local interface; it does not produce the protagonist's innate powers or restore outside communications. Keep a clear visual separation between hard protective plates and soft textile, with carefully designed strap routing and modest ordinary belt equipment.
Layout: elegant landscape 3:2 presentation on warm light-gray background. Dominant full-body three-quarter FRONT view on left; smaller fully consistent full-body REAR in center; enlarged closed helmet detail upper right; compact subjective in-helmet HUD study lower right. Every standing view includes entire head and both boot soles with margins, empty relaxed hands. No weapon. HUD study shows a neutral forward-view interior, sparse dim cyan/white peripheral display marks, clear unobstructed center; no face, invented enemy detection or telemetry claims. Header text "MERIDIAN / 2043", variant label "16 / DATUM"; inset label "HUD STUDY / PROPOSAL". Beautiful polished painterly character art, refined silhouette and shape hierarchy, exceptionally convincing matte composites, woven cloth, rubber and leather, restrained wear, soft directional light making every armor layer legible. Do not copy reference anatomy errors, logos, text layout or plate designs exactly; this is a distinct new design in the same family.
basis: Multica artist Concept02 brief.md Datum matrix and shared direction; controller prompt assembled during artist prompt finalization.

prompt:
Create one exceptional professional character concept sheet for an original MERIDIAN operative in 2043, a realistic dark near future. Use both supplied Cutline and Overlap reference images for their shared tactical construction language; develop the specified new design. Keep athletic adult human proportions, compact head and shoulders, restrained load carriage, and credible shallow composite armor over textile. The character must visibly carry more armor than either reference while remaining mobile.

Use a landscape sheet: dominant full-body front three-quarter at left, smaller matching full-body rear centrally, enlarged closed helmet detail at upper right, compact subjective in-helmet HUD study below it. Keep both figures' entire heads and boot soles inside generous margins. Match helmet, plate seams, closures and materials across views. Stand naturally with arms slightly separated and empty gloved hands. Show no weapon. Use a neutral warm-gray background, controlled material painting, readable shadows, subtle wear, graphite composite, muted olive or ash fabric, and dark practical boots. English header: MERIDIAN / 2043. Add the specified ID and name.

Show articulated chest, back, flank and abdominal protection, compact outer shoulder plates, forearm guards, thigh armor, distinct knee caps and shin plates. Keep visible textile flex zones at neck, armpits, elbows, waist, hip creases, knees, wrists and ankles, plus clear rifle-stock seats. Avoid oversized pauldrons, rigid limb tubes, powered armor, exoskeletons, armor skirts and gadget clutter.

Completely conceal face, eyes and skin: opaque black visor, closed shallow hard mask, sealed textile collar and gloves. Integrate the helmet computer into small temple or occipital volumes with recessed service seams and protected display optics behind the visor. No external electronics box, exposed cables, luminous face, hologram or power core.

Label the HUD inset HUD STUDY / PROPOSAL. Show an unobstructed forward view into plain neutral space, sparse dim peripheral brackets and one small abstract menu mark, without a human face or cutaway. These are speculative local interface marks: no targeting, sensing, anomaly readout, numerical telemetry, command contact, orders or ability indicators. The helmet is ordinary equipment; personal abilities do not originate in it.

17 / TRAVERSE. Extend Overlap's diagonal construction into two broad breast leaves crossing along one restrained oblique lap, followed by two short staggered abdominal tabs ending above the hip creases. Carry the diagonal overlap across the upper back, with independent lower back and flank segments. Avoid a hanging torso flap. Use two small overlapping outer shoulder leaves, oblique forearm guards, short outer thigh shields, separate compact knees and tapered shin plates. Construct a compact helmet with an offset crown seam, narrow continuous opaque visor and two closed jaw shells overlapping diagonally across the lower face. House the computer inside the thicker rear temple on the same side as the upper jaw leaf; describe its presence with a recessed service outline, never a bolt-on box. Let ash edge bindings separate graphite plates from olive textile. Make diagonal armor layering legible at full-body scale while keeping both stock seats open.
basis: Multica Concept Art Astra/max/standard common_prompt plus variant prompt.
